title: sk.config.json
description: A Skathi app's configuration, read by sk dev, sk build, sk publish and sk check. Unknown top-level keys are warnings; unknown keys under "windows", "macos" and a pack are errors.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file is checked against in the editor; ignored by sk.

name.description: The app's identity: names its storage directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%\<name>\storage on Windows) and its devtools slot. Default: the app directory's name.

productName.description: The display name, stamped into the exe and the bundle. Default: window.title, else name.

renderer.description: The DOM renderer supports the full Skathi feature set. The experimental native renderer requires Svelte 5.59.0 or later in major 5.

version.description: The app's version: semver ("1.2.3", "1.2.3-beta.1"), up to four numeric parts of at most 65535. Default: package.json "version", else 0.0.0 with a warning.

platforms.description: The OSes sk publish packages for. Default: this OS only.

window.description: The main window, as the host opens it.

minWidth.description: Minimum width in logical pixels. Above 500, Windows 11 snap layouts reject the window.

x.description: Where the window opens: logical pixels from the left of the monitor's work area. Without it the window is centred horizontally. Kept inside the work area.

y.description: Where the window opens: logical pixels from the top of the monitor's work area. Without it the window is centred vertically. Kept inside the work area.

center.description: true: the window opens centred on its monitor's work area, which is also what happens without x and y. With x or y it wins, with a warning.

monitor.description: The monitor the window opens on: "primary" (default), "cursor" (the one under the mouse pointer; Windows only, elsewhere the primary) or an index from 0. A missing index opens on the primary monitor with an advisory.

frame.description: false only prints an advisory: the window keeps its frame, shadow, animations and edge resizing. Hide the OS title bar with titleBarStyle "hidden".

titleBarStyle.description: "default": the OS draws the title bar. "hidden": the app draws it (default). "hiddenInset": treated as "hidden" on every OS, with an advisory.

titleBarHeight.description: Height of the app-drawn title bar strip, in logical pixels.

titleBarFallback.description: Draw a host title bar strip until the app paints its first app-region: drag area. Default true; ignored with titleBarStyle "default".

titleBarOverlay.description: The caption buttons drawn over the app's own title bar: true, false, or their height and colors.

color.description: Background color of the caption buttons (a CSS color).

symbolColor.description: Glyph color of the caption buttons (a CSS color).

backdrop.description: The window material behind transparent content. blur is acrylic; tabbed is mica-alt; opaque is none.

resizable.description: Whether the user can resize the window.

minimizable.description: Whether the window has a minimize button.

maximizable.description: Whether the window can be maximized.

alwaysOnTop.description: Keep the window above other windows.

focus.description: "raise": window.focus() brings the window to the front and takes the keyboard. Without it, focus() only requests attention (a taskbar flash or Dock bounce). It does not change how the window opens.

devtools.description: Overrides the top-level "devtools" for this window.
false turns the devtools listener and F12 off at start in a host that carries them; the app can turn them on later.

publishDevtools.description: true: sk publish keeps devtools (F12, the inspector) in the published app. Default false; sk build always has them.

publishJit.description: false: an AOT sk publish for Windows x64 stamps the aot-nojit workload, whose engine has no JIT and no WebAssembly (about 14 MB smaller, no devtools). The app runs only from its native image, as an AOT app does anyway; SK_APP_ENGINE=jit is refused, and sk publish refuses an image that names WebAssembly. Default true. Since 0.6.

publishSingleFile.description: true: sk publish writes one exe and nothing beside it. The ICU data and every asset (packs included) go into its payload, and with AOT (Windows x64) the native images become sections of the exe, mapped where they lie. Windows and Linux; a macOS app is a bundle and refuses it. Default false: they ship beside the exe. Since 0.6.

aot.description: true: sk build and sk publish compile the app's JavaScript to a native image the exe runs instead of interpreting it (Windows x64 only for now). sk check errors refuse the build. --aot and --no-aot override it; sk dev always runs the JavaScript.

intl.description: The ICU locale data sk build and sk publish ship on Windows and Linux. "full": every locale, as icu.skpk (about 12 MB) beside the app. "invariant": the root locale only: Intl and toLocale* format dates, numbers and lists the root way ("2024 M01 15", "1,234.5") whatever locale is asked for, localeCompare and Intl.Collator sort by the root order, Intl.DisplayNames returns the codes it is given, and Intl.Segmenter finds no words in Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Khmer, Lao or Burmese text. Nothing throws. sk dev and macOS always have every locale.

memory.description: How much memory the allocators in the process keep in reserve (since 0.7). "default": freed memory is held for a moment to be reused, and a page is committed whole when it is taken. "low": a page is committed as it fills and freed memory goes back to the system at once, in the JS engine's allocator and in a GPU driver's that reads the same settings (NVIDIA's does). Less memory, slower bursts of allocation. The SK_MEMORY environment variable, set to low or default, decides over this.

assets.description: Directories or globs, relative to the app root, packaged with the app. Default: ["assets"].

publicDir.description: Vite's public/ directory, relative to the app root and inside it: its files are packaged keyed relative to it. false or absent: none.

packs.description: Assets in their own .skpk files beside the app, in order. A pack without "match" takes every asset no earlier pack took.

name.description: The pack's file name, <name>.skpk: lowercase letters, digits, "-" or "_", not "app".

match.description: Globs over asset keys that go in this pack. Absent: the rest.

define.description: Vite's define: global names replaced by these values in the bundle.

aliases.description: A bare module name and the app file, relative to the app root, standing in for it everywhere (the JS half of a native extension).

allow.description: A check code and the package names or app-relative globs whose diagnostics of that code are not reported.

id.description: The launch identity, reverse-DNS style ("gl.argon.notes"): names the single-instance lock and the URL scheme registration. Default: name.

singleInstance.description: A second launch hands its arguments to the running instance and exits. Default false.

raiseOnSecondInstance.description: With singleInstance, a second launch brings the running window to the front. Default true.

protocols.description: URL schemes the app registers for ("myapp" for myapp://...). Browser and Windows schemes (http, file, ms-*, ...) are refused. Use with singleInstance.

windows.description: The Windows exe. Unknown keys are errors.

exeName.description: The exe's file name, without .exe. Default: productName.

icon.description: An .ico or a square .png, relative to the app root. Also the macOS icon unless macos.icon is set.

company.description: CompanyName in the exe's version info.

copyright.description: LegalCopyright in the exe's version info; also the macOS copyright unless macos.copyright is set.

description.description: FileDescription in the exe's version info.

console.description: Build a console-subsystem exe that keeps its console window.

macos.description: The macOS .app bundle. Unknown keys are errors.

bundleId.description: CFBundleIdentifier, reverse-DNS ("gl.argon.notes"). Default: id, with "_" as "-".

icon.description: A square .png or an .icns, relative to the app root. Default: windows.icon.

microphoneUsageDescription.description: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: why the app asks for the microphone.

cameraUsageDescription.description: NSCameraUsageDescription: why the app asks for the camera.

sign.description: A codesign identity, "-" to sign ad hoc, or false to leave the bundle unsigned. Default: ad hoc where codesign exists.

colorPicker.description: What <input type="color"> opens. "builtin": Skathi's picker, drawn in the window under the input. "system": the OS color dialog (ChooseColor on Windows, NSColorPanel on macOS, zenity or kdialog on Linux).

httpCache.description: The disk HTTP cache: { "maxMB": N } caps it (0 turns it off); false turns it off. Default 256 MB.

maxMB.description: The cap in megabytes; 0 = no cache.
